key.description: The merchant ID that was provided by PayU.

txnid.description: The transaction ID is a reference number for a specific order that is generated by the merchant.

amount.description: The payment amount for the transaction.

productinfo.description: A brief description of the product.

firstname.description: The first name of the customer.

surl.description: The success URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is successful.

furl.description: The Failure URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is failed.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

pg.description: The pg parameter determines which payment payment mode must be enabled for your integration. For EMI as payment mode, EMI must be  used.

bankcode.description: Each payment option is identified with a unique bank code at PayU. The merchant must post this parameter with the corresponding payment option’s bank code value in it.

ccnum.description: Use 13-19 digit card number for credit/debit cards (15 digits for AMEX, 13-19 for Maestro) and validate with LUHN algorithm. Use the Test card details as listed in the Test Cards, UPI ID and Wallets section.

ccvv.description: Use 3-digit CVV number for credit/debit cards and 4-digit security code (4DBC/CID) for AMEX cards. Validate with BIN API.

ccname.description: This parameter must contain the name on card – as entered by the customer for the transaction.

ccexpmon.description: This parameter must contain the card’s expiry month – as entered by the user for the transaction. It must always be in 2 digits or in MM format. For months 1-9, this parameter must be appended with 0 – like 01, 02…09. For months 10-12, this parameter must not be appended – It should be 10,11 and 12 respectively.

ccexpyr.description: This parameter must contain the card’s expiry year – as entered by the customer for the transaction. It must be of four digits.

hash.description: It is the hash calculated by the merchant. The format for calculating the hash: sha512(key|txnid|amount|productinfo|firstname|email|udf1|udf2|udf3|udf4|udf5||||||SALT)

phone.description: The phone number of the customer. Use the phone number specified as listed in the Test Cards, UPI ID and Wallets section.

lastname.description: The last name of the customer.

curl.description: The Cancel URL, which is the page PayU will redirect to if the transaction is cancelled by customer.

udf1.description: User-defined fields (udf) are used to store any information corresponding to a particular transaction. You can use up to five udfs in the post designated as udf1, udf2, udf3, udf4, udf5.
